judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.M. Subramaniam, J.:— When the matter came up for hearing on 08.08.2019, there was no representation on behalf the writ petitioner and hence, it was posted today i.e., 09.08.2019 under the caption “For Dismissal”. Even today i.e., 09.08.2019, when the matter was taken up for hearing, there was no representation for the writ petitioner. In such circumstances, this Court has no other option except to dismiss the writ petition for non-prosecution.

2. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed for non-prosecution. No costs. Consequently, connected civil miscellaneous petition is closed.
